# [STORY] As a user, I want to upload custom profile avatars and review attachments so that I can personalize my identity and reactions on the platform

## User Story
As a registered user
I want to upload custom profile avatars and media attachments on movie review comments
So that I can personalize my identity and share visual commentary across the platform

## Parent Epic
Parent: #35

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a logged-in user on their Profile screen, when they upload a custom avatar image, then the file is sent to the media service and their displayed avatar icon updates instantly
- [x] Given a logged-in user writing a movie review, when they attach a verification image or video clip, then the media service processes the file and displays the thumbnail preview within their review
